# Audio fixture attribution

[cafe-conversation.wav](cafe-conversation.wav) is a 2-second excerpt, from 00:30
to 00:32, of [Café ambiance](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Cafe_ambiance.ogg)
by Marble Toast. The creator released the original under the
[CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
The excerpt was downmixed to mono and written as 16-bit PCM at the original
sample rate. It contains café conversation and room noise.
